def pareto_frontier_indices_minx_maxy(df, x_col, y_col):
    d = df[[x_col, y_col]].dropna().copy()
    d = d.sort_values([x_col, y_col], ascending=[True, False])

    pareto_idx = []
    best_y = -np.inf
    for idx, row in d.iterrows():
        if row[y_col] > best_y:
            pareto_idx.append(idx)
            best_y = row[y_col]
    return pareto_idx


def plot_metric_vs_accuracy_pareto(
    df,
    x_col,                               
    y_col="Acurácia Média",
    label_col="Modelo",
    x_mode="min",                     
    figsize=(8.0, 5.5),
    font_size=11,
    marker_size=70,
    pareto_marker_size=130,
    alpha_other=0.35,
    alpha_pareto=0.95,
    annotate_all=True,
    annotate_only_pareto=False,
    text_offset=(6, 6),
    text_rotation=0,
    grid=True,
    title=None,
    x_label=None,
    y_label="Acurácia média",
    x_log=False,
    x_limits=None,
    y_limits=None,
    pareto_line=True,
    save_path=None,
    dpi=300
):
    cols = [x_col, y_col, label_col]
    d = df[cols].dropna().copy()

    if x_mode == "min":
        d = d.sort_values([x_col, y_col], ascending=[True, False])
        pareto_idx = pareto_frontier_indices_minx_maxy(d, x_col, y_col)
    elif x_mode == "max":
        d["_x_inv"] = -d[x_col]
        d = d.sort_values(["_x_inv", y_col], ascending=[True, False])
        pareto_idx = pareto_frontier_indices_minx_maxy(d, "_x_inv", y_col)
        d = d.drop(columns=["_x_inv"])
    else:
        raise ValueError("x_mode must be 'min' or 'max'")

    p = d.loc[pareto_idx].copy()
    p = p.sort_values(x_col, ascending=True)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)

    ax.scatter(
        d[x_col], d[y_col],
        s=marker_size,
        alpha=alpha_other,
        label="Modelos"
    )

    # Pareto
    ax.scatter(
        p[x_col], p[y_col],
        s=pareto_marker_size,
        marker="D",
        alpha=alpha_pareto,
        label="Fronteira de Pareto"
    )

    if pareto_line and len(p) >= 2:
        ax.plot(p[x_col], p[y_col], linestyle="--", linewidth=1)

    def _annotate_rows(dd):
        for _, r in dd.iterrows():
            ax.annotate(
                str(r[label_col]),
                (r[x_col], r[y_col]),
                xytext=text_offset,
                textcoords="offset points",
                fontsize=font_size - 2,
                rotation=text_rotation,
                ha="left",
                va="bottom"
            )

    if annotate_only_pareto:
        _annotate_rows(p)
    elif annotate_all:
        _annotate_rows(d)

    if x_label is None:
        x_label = x_col
    if title is None:
        direction = "min" if x_mode == "min" else "max"
        title = f"{y_col} vs {x_col} (Pareto, x={direction})"

    ax.set_xlabel(x_label, fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label, fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=font_size + 1)

    if x_log:
        ax.set_xscale("log")
    if x_limits is not None:
        ax.set_xlim(*x_limits)
    if y_limits is not None:
        ax.set_ylim(*y_limits)

    if grid:
        ax.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)

    ax.legend(fontsize=font_size - 2)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=font_size - 2)
    plt.tight_layout()

    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")

    plt.show()

def plot_grouped_bar_metrics(
    df,
    model_col="Modelo",
    metrics=("Acurácia Média",),
    order_by=None,                 
    ascending=False,
    top_k=None,                    
    figsize=(10, 5.5),
    font_size=11,
    rotate_xticks=45,
    grid=True,
    legend=True,
    title=None,
    y_label=None,
    y_limits=None,
    value_format=None,             
    save_path=None,
    dpi=300
):
    if isinstance(metrics, str):
        metrics = (metrics,)

    cols = [model_col, *metrics]
    d = df[cols].dropna().copy()

    if order_by is None:
        order_by = metrics[0]

    if order_by in d.columns:
        d = d.sort_values(order_by, ascending=ascending)

    if top_k is not None:
        d = d.head(top_k)

    models = d[model_col].astype(str).tolist()
    n_models = len(models)
    n_metrics = len(metrics)

    x = np.arange(n_models)
    width = 0.8 / max(n_metrics, 1)  

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)

    for i, m in enumerate(metrics):
        offsets = x + (i - (n_metrics - 1) / 2) * width
        bars = ax.bar(offsets, d[m].to_numpy(), width=width, label=m)

        # rótulos numéricos no topo (opcional)
        if value_format is not None:
            for b in bars:
                h = b.get_height()
                ax.annotate(
                    value_format.format(h),
                    (b.get_x() + b.get_width() / 2, h),
                    ha="center",
                    va="bottom",
                    fontsize=font_size - 3,
                    xytext=(0, 2),
                    textcoords="offset points"
                )

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(models, rotation=rotate_xticks, ha="right", fontsize=font_size - 2)

    if y_label is None:
        y_label = "Métrica"
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label, fontsize=font_size)

    if title is not None:
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=font_size + 1)

    if y_limits is not None:
        ax.set_ylim(*y_limits)

    if grid:
        ax.grid(True, axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)

    if legend and n_metrics > 1:
        ax.legend(fontsize=font_size - 2)

    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=font_size - 2)
    plt.tight_layout()

    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")

    plt.show()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def pareto_frontier_indices_minx_maxy(df, x_col, y_col):
    d = df[[x_col, y_col]].dropna().copy()
    d = d.sort_values([x_col, y_col], ascending=[True, False])

    pareto_idx = []
    best_y = -np.inf
    for idx, row in d.iterrows():
        if row[y_col] > best_y:
            pareto_idx.append(idx)
            best_y = row[y_col]
    return pareto_idx


def _ensure_order(seq, order=None):
    if order is None:
        return list(seq)
    # mantém apenas os que existem
    return [x for x in order if x in set(seq)]


def plot_heatmap_model_vs_class(
    data_class,
    metric="f1",
    model_col="model",
    class_col="class",
    figsize=(10, 6),
    font_size=11,
    title=None,
    x_label="Classe",
    y_label="Modelo",
    model_order=None,
    class_order=None,
    vmin=0.0,
    vmax=1.0,
    show_values=False,
    value_fmt="{:.2f}",
    save_path=None,
    dpi=300
):
    mat = data_class.pivot_table(index=model_col, columns=class_col, values=metric, aggfunc="mean")

    mat = mat.loc[_ensure_order(mat.index, model_order)]
    mat = mat[_ensure_order(mat.columns, class_order)]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    im = ax.imshow(mat.values, aspect="auto", vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)

    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(mat.shape[1]))
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(mat.shape[0]))
    ax.set_xticklabels(mat.columns.tolist(), fontsize=font_size - 2)
    ax.set_yticklabels(mat.index.tolist(), fontsize=font_size - 2)

    ax.set_xlabel(x_label, fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label, fontsize=font_size)

    if title is None:
        title = f"Heatmap: {metric.upper()} por modelo e classe"
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=font_size + 1)

    cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax)
    cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=font_size - 2)

    if show_values:
        for i in range(mat.shape[0]):
            for j in range(mat.shape[1]):
                val = mat.values[i, j]
                if np.isfinite(val):
                    ax.text(j, i, value_fmt.format(val), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=font_size - 4)

    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()


def plot_hardest_classes(
    data_class,
    metric="f1",
    class_col="class",
    agg="mean",              
    ascending=True,          
    top_k=None,
    figsize=(9, 5),
    font_size=11,
    title=None,
    y_label=None,
    value_format="{:.3f}",
    save_path=None,
    dpi=300
):
    g = data_class.groupby(class_col)[metric]
    s = (g.mean() if agg == "mean" else g.median()).sort_values(ascending=ascending)

    if top_k is not None:
        s = s.head(top_k)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    ax.bar(s.index.astype(str), s.values)

    ax.set_xlabel("Classe", fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label or metric.upper(), fontsize=font_size)

    if title is None:
        title = f"Classes mais difíceis ({metric.upper()} {agg})"
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=font_size + 1)

    ax.grid(True, axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=font_size - 2)

    # rótulos no topo
    for i, v in enumerate(s.values):
        ax.text(i, v, value_format.format(v), ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=font_size - 3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()


def plot_best_model_per_class(
    data_class,
    metric="f1",
    model_col="model",
    class_col="class",
    figsize=(10, 5),
    font_size=11,
    title=None,
    y_label=None,
    annotate_model=True,
    value_format="{:.3f}",
    save_path=None,
    dpi=300
):
    winners = (
        data_class.sort_values([class_col, metric], ascending=[True, False])
        .groupby(class_col)
        .head(1)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    x = winners[class_col].astype(str).tolist()
    y = winners[metric].to_numpy()
    labels = winners[model_col].astype(str).tolist()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    ax.bar(x, y)

    ax.set_xlabel("Classe", fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label or metric.upper(), fontsize=font_size)

    if title is None:
        title = f"Melhor modelo por classe ({metric.upper()})"
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=font_size + 1)

    ax.grid(True, axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=font_size - 2)

    if annotate_model:
        for i, (v, m) in enumerate(zip(y, labels)):
            ax.text(i, v, f"{m}\n{value_format.format(v)}", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=font_size - 3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()



def plot_pareto_for_one_class(
    data_class2,
    class_id,
    x_col="[Real] Latência Média (ms)",
    y_metric="f1",
    model_col="model",
    class_col="class",
    figsize=(8, 5.5),
    font_size=11,
    marker_size=70,
    pareto_marker_size=130,
    alpha_other=0.35,
    alpha_pareto=0.95,
    annotate_all=True,
    text_offset=(6, 6),
    grid=True,
    title=None,
    x_label=None,
    y_label=None,
    x_log=False,
    save_path=None,
    dpi=300
):
    d = data_class2[data_class2[class_col] == class_id].copy()
    d = d[[x_col, y_metric, model_col]].dropna()
    d = d.sort_values([x_col, y_metric], ascending=[True, False])

    pareto_idx = pareto_frontier_indices_minx_maxy(d, x_col, y_metric)
    p = d.loc[pareto_idx].sort_values(x_col)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    ax.scatter(d[x_col], d[y_metric], s=marker_size, alpha=alpha_other, label="Modelos")
    ax.scatter(p[x_col], p[y_metric], s=pareto_marker_size, marker="D", alpha=alpha_pareto, label="Pareto")
    if len(p) >= 2:
        ax.plot(p[x_col], p[y_metric], linestyle="--", linewidth=1)

    if annotate_all:
        for _, r in d.iterrows():
            ax.annotate(str(r[model_col]), (r[x_col], r[y_metric]),
                        xytext=text_offset, textcoords="offset points",
                        fontsize=font_size - 2, ha="left", va="bottom")

    if x_label is None:
        x_label = x_col
    if y_label is None:
        y_label = f"{y_metric.upper()} (classe {class_id})"
    if title is None:
        title = f"Classe {class_id}: {y_metric.upper()} vs {x_col} (Pareto)"

    ax.set_xlabel(x_label, fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label, fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=font_size + 1)

    if x_log:
        ax.set_xscale("log")
    if grid:
        ax.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)

    ax.legend(fontsize=font_size - 2)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=font_size - 2)

    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def plot_model_cost_bars(
    df,
    model_col="Modelo",
    metric_col="Parâmetros (M)",
    order_by=None,               # default = metric_col
    ascending=True,
    top_k=None,
    figsize=(10, 5.5),
    font_size=11,
    rotate_xticks=45,
    grid=True,
    title=None,
    y_label=None,
    value_format="{:.2f}",
    save_path=None,
    dpi=300
):
    
    cols = [model_col, metric_col]
    d = df[cols].dropna().copy()

    if order_by is None:
        order_by = metric_col

    d = d.sort_values(order_by, ascending=ascending)
    if top_k is not None:
        d = d.head(top_k)

    x = d[model_col].astype(str).tolist()
    y = d[metric_col].to_numpy()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
    ax.bar(x, y)

    ax.set_xlabel("Modelo", fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label or metric_col, fontsize=font_size)

    if title is None:
        title = f"{metric_col} por modelo"
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=font_size + 1)

    ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=font_size - 2)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=font_size - 2)
    ax.set_xticklabels(x, rotation=rotate_xticks, ha="right")

    if grid:
        ax.grid(True, axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)

    for i, v in enumerate(y):
        ax.text(i, v, value_format.format(v), ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=font_size - 3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()


def plot_flops_macs_grouped(
    df,
    model_col="Modelo",
    flops_col="GFLOPs",
    macs_col="GMAC",
    order_by="GFLOPs",
    ascending=True,
    top_k=None,
    figsize=(11, 6),
    font_size=11,
    rotate_xticks=45,
    grid=True,
    title="Operações por modelo (GFLOPs e GMAC)",
    y_label="Operações",
    value_format=None,
    save_path=None,
    dpi=300
):
    cols = [model_col, flops_col, macs_col]
    d = df[cols].dropna().copy()

    if order_by in d.columns:
        d = d.sort_values(order_by, ascending=ascending)

    if top_k is not None:
        d = d.head(top_k)

    models = d[model_col].astype(str).tolist()
    x = np.arange(len(models))
    width = 0.38

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)

    b1 = ax.bar(x - width/2, d[flops_col].to_numpy(), width, label=flops_col)
    b2 = ax.bar(x + width/2, d[macs_col].to_numpy(), width, label=macs_col)

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(models, rotation=rotate_xticks, ha="right", fontsize=font_size - 2)

    ax.set_xlabel("Modelo", fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label, fontsize=font_size)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=font_size + 1)

    if grid:
        ax.grid(True, axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)

    ax.legend(fontsize=font_size - 2)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=font_size - 2)

    if value_format is not None:
        for bars in (b1, b2):
            for b in bars:
                h = b.get_height()
                ax.annotate(
                    value_format.format(h),
                    (b.get_x() + b.get_width()/2, h),
                    ha="center", va="bottom",
                    fontsize=font_size - 3,
                    xytext=(0, 2), textcoords="offset points"
                )

    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
